segments.name: Cybersecurity
products: corporate endpoint and cloud workload security
segments.description: Cloud-native cybersecurity platform whose cloud modules protect endpoints, cloud workloads, identities and AI systems for organizations worldwide.
segments.evidence: CrowdStrike's Chief Operating Decision Maker ("CODM"), the Chief Executive Officer, manages the Company's business activities as a single operating and reportable segment at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for cloud modules on the Falcon platform, with additional professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: Today, we offer 33 cloud modules on our Falcon platform via a SaaS subscription-based model that spans multiple large markets, including corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security services, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, next-generation security information and event management ("SIEM") and log management, threat intelligence services, data protection, SaaS security posture management, Security Orchestration, Automation
